Xprinter XP-233B 2-in-1 Direct Thermal Barcode Label and Receipt Printer

Streamline your business operations with the versatile Xprinter XP-233B 2-in-1 Direct Thermal Printer. Available at Turbo Computer, this compact and cost-effective hardware solution functions as both a high-quality barcode label printer and a standard retail receipt printer. It stands as the definitive choice for small-to-medium retail shops, pharmacies, and warehouse managers across Egypt looking for an immediate hardware modification to enhance checkout configurations and inventory tracking performance.

The Xprinter XP-233B utilizes advanced direct thermal technology, eliminating the ongoing costs of expensive ink cartridges or ribbons. Featuring a space-saving design, it delivers crisp print quality at a fast speed of up to 101mm/s for labels and 90mm/s for receipts. With integrated auto-calibration, open-cover sensor protection, and an easy-to-use USB connectivity interface, it provides a highly reliable and completely stress-free daily desktop ecosystem.
